decision_basis: Phase 1 validation-only comparison (aisc_v16_phase1_feature_freeze.md): A=0.9278, B(drop whole generation_provenance group)=0.9636, C1(drop deterministic_rank+fuzzy_rank only)=0.9639, C2(drop reason_* only)=0.9273.
